name: Missing Piece
scaffolding_intent: A jigsaw-piece-shaped hole opens in the scene where an entity from another scene would be, exposing the flat pixel background; the piece, bearing that entity's silhouette, hovers at the frame edge then fades, and the hole closes

parameters.name: holeScale
parameters.description: Size of the hole relative to the absent entity's bounding box

parameters.name: edgePulse
parameters.description: Intensity of the pulsing outline on the hole edge

correction_intent: Child referenced an entity that is NOT in the current scene but exists in another scene of the same story (e.g. mentioning the dog from scene 1 while narrating scene 3, where the dog is absent). The target is the ID of that entity as it appears in the other scene. Do NOT use when the child misnames an entity that IS present (that is I1_spotlight), when the child states a wrong number for a present group (that is C1_sequential_glow), or when the mentioned entity exists in no scene of the story.
suggestion_intent: An entity that appeared in a previous scene, or that will appear in an upcoming scene, is absent from the current scene, and the child has not accounted for it (where it went, why it is not here, whether it will come back). The target is the ID of that entity in the other scene. Use only when the absence is narratively meaningful for continuity, not for background objects.
